items.description: Report does not define which callers count as authorized rebalancers, so caller_is_authorized is a qualitative Boolean.

The report does not define a concrete threshold or observable for 'transaction congestion' or 'delaying or blocking critical rebalancing operations'; the impact is represented as a grounded Boolean occurrence.
Report does not establish that a prior processTransfer() redemption occurred before the rebalanceFunds() call; the under-collateralization scenario is only potential.
Report does not give numeric collateralization thresholds or vault balance values; under-collateralization is represented as a grounded Boolean observable.

Report does not give the numeric excess amount or the balance accounting that would let the double drain be expressed as an amount-level relation; represented as a grounded Boolean occurrence of draining excess twice.
